epistemic_status: EXPLORATORY AFTER opening all six original source movement outcomes and group-averaged ERA5 context; freeze new within-animal DATE-PAIR association estimands BEFORE opening individual paired-date temperature/water slopes. No causal identification, no prospectively blinded confirmation.
main_ecological_question: Within a marked mammal and its original year-specific equal-daylength comparison, does the magnitude of seasonal regional air-temperature difference covary with its change in relative nighttime GPS displacement? Is this association consistent across independent original recruitment cohorts, or heterogeneous beyond group-level climate signs?

source_cohorts.known_four_source_holds_and_one_zero_moo: Do NOT include new source files to rescue signs or n. All prior failed source entries remain explicit in existing ledger.

weather.source: historical Open-Meteo, models=era5, no new provider; use exactly original six already registered public coarse source reference points
weather.fixed_timezone: same source-local standard clock from rounded longitude / 15 as previous successful workflows; no GPS-local microclimate inferred
covariates: falling minus rising daily mean air temperature at original paired dates (°C)
weather.climate_missingness: No interpolation/filling; use only original GPS-date pairs with complete source ERA5, report missing original pairs. Preserve original group GPS effect even when weather missing.
weather.coarse_exposure_limit: One weather grid per source and shared dates among individual GPS animals are NOT independent weather replicates; modeled P−ET0 is not soil moisture/forage.

response.locked: per animal-year exact original 1:1 paired dates <=5 min photoperiod mismatch, >=30 d apart, 0.5-2h GPS steps, >=3 per solar daypart, sample ratio 0.5-2, >=10 original source matched pairs per year
response.Y: per already-frozen original date pair, falling minus rising in [log1p(NIGHT median straight-line GPS displacement km/h) − log1p(DAY median displacement km/h)]
response.no_recalculation: MUST reproduce original per-source exactly group-mean and animal-count v0 result BEFORE requesting ERA5, using same scripts.movebank_regional_climate_link_20261019.locked_pairs() imported helper, never update original estimators.
response.no_percent_change: Raw numeric log1p km/h scale is not animal activity percentage or energy use.

date_pair_association.unit: Same original individually marked animal×solar year, original GPS matched date pairs; associations within year calculated first; then equal years within individual; then equal animals within source.
separate_slopes: βW = same slope with x=Δ30d(P−ET0) /100mm so units log1p(km/h) per 100 mm
date_pair_association.data_thresholds: An original eligible animal×year requires >=10 ORIGINAL pairs, and source complete weather for >=10 matched pairs. Individual-year βT shown only if SD(ΔT)>0.5°C. βW shown only if SD(Δ30d(P−ET0))>10mm. These are fixed numerical-identifiability floors; no after-result rescue.
date_pair_association.aggregation: Mean eligible-year slope within each unique individual, then mean/median/sign of original independent individuals per source. Each animal counts once and individuals repeated across years are NOT independent populations.
date_pair_association.descriptive_outputs: For each source and each predictor: original n animals, n with valid slope, n eligible years and paired dates, n positive/negative/exact zero slopes, average/median slope, leave-one-animal-out mean range (NOT CI), slope undefined counts. The exact six originally named cohorts all reported.
date_pair_association.strict_stop: No optimizing lag, time window, source, correlation, test threshold, date-pair selection, sensor day-night definition or binarization after opening slopes. NO pooled source-independent p-values or cross-source hierarchical variance components, and no p-value from pair pseudoreplication.

ecological_claim_ceiling: Within-animal source date-pair slope on a shared regional modeled climate series is an observational seasonal co-trend, not a thermoregulatory causal coefficient or independent climate randomization.
Individuals reuse weather dates, and GPS time series are autocorrelated; no individual source bootstrap alone fixes shared calendar dependence.
Each source from one species/location/collar cohort is confounded; six slopes cannot establish a global conditional law.
GPS minimum straight-line displacement is not an activity budget, nor directly observed foraging/water visitation.
Do not force one coefficient sign across six cohorts; null/undefined/small mixed slopes are equally reportable.
Earlier Serengeti camera, global ERA5 grid and duck GPS instantaneous speed are not the same endpoint and must not be pooled as corroborating animal counts.
